study type: Observational case-control study comparing human tissue samples, complemented by in vitro experiments using HUVECs.
outcome: Endothelial cell layer damage in placental artery
cohort: Pregnant women with severe preeclampsia and normal pregnant women, from whom placental artery and blood serum were collected.
finding: The study found markedly decreased TRPV1, KATP (Kir6.1/SUR2B), and eNOS expression, along with lower NO levels and endothelial cell damage in severe preeclampsia patients, suggesting that impairment of endothelial TRPV1-KATP channels leads to decreased eNOS/NO pathway activity, contributing to severe preeclampsia.
